meta.window: TRAIN 2019-01-01..2023-12-31 (nothing from 2024 on simulated or scored; 2026 never read)
meta.note: evalv's metric definitions and smoothing (winner p = (A wins + 0.5) / (decisive + 1), clipped 0.005..0.995; 7-bin smoothed by one pseudo-sim of train base rates). softCE = -(q log p + (1-q) log(1-p)), q = market.json p_power_close, on every train fight with a close. devTot = mean over sig_lnd, sig_att, td_lnd, ctrl, kd of the per-fight Poisson deviance divided by the all-on arm's train mean (x100 = mean relative change in %). Paired: arm minus all, ratio estimator over event-date clusters; pWorse = bootstrap share of resamples where the arm is worse than all (for acc: higher is better, so read it reversed).
